backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only PIT Form 4 C/A non-derivative conversion rows on usable_trade_date plus close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date. Eligible rows must have no same-accession same-owner S/F D sale or tax-disposal, retain at least 1x converted shares afterward, and clear $500k converted market value at signal close. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate3_survival_note: Core survival is checked by BASE_GATE4. Target survival is a default-off overlay candidate sample; no additional filter is added after Gate 3.

2_history_check.novelty_gate: scripts/experiment.py new returned ok: no strong near-neighbor. Nearest Form 4 families were option-exercise retention, post-sale retention, sale absorption, and tax withholding, but none tested C-code class-conversion A rows with same-accession S/F disposal exclusion.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: One fixed policy bundle: PIT-safe Form 4 non-derivative rows must have transaction_code=C, acquired_disposed_code=A, usable_trade_date, positive shares, post-conversion shares >= converted shares, no same-accession same-owner S/F D disposal, and ticker-day converted market value >= $500k using signal-day close. The inherited liquid leadership envelope, same-ticker core overlap exclusion, top-1 next-open paper entry, 10-day hold, costs, cooldown, comparator, and concentration gates are unchanged.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Treat as positive replay lead only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window appears, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration guard passes, and both accepted compression and distribution comparators are beaten. A shared default-off helper and daily parity path are required for any retention.

The inherited liquid SPY-relative leadership envelope keeps this from being a raw noisy ticker add.
interpretation: The Form 4 conversion no-disposal source was rejected; it did not establish a distinct free SEC Form 4/OHLCV candidate-pool edge under the standard three-window protocol.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that C-code conversions are routine class mechanics, compensation plumbing, or tightly paired with insider sale plans. The no-S/F-disposal gate may remove obvious sale events but still leave only a tiny set of liquid leadership names already captured by the inherited OHLCV envelope. Do not answer by sweeping conversion-value thresholds, post-conversion retention ratios, owner roles, 10b5-1 flags, top-N, notional, hold days, or cooldown on these frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A valid retry needs materially new PIT evidence beyond raw C-code rows, such as parsed conversion purpose/lockup or selling-plan context, forward daily replacement observations from a shared default-off adapter, or 13D/13G holder-intent evidence that distinguishes control-holder supply relief from routine class conversion mechanics.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping conversion-value thresholds, post-conversion retention ratios, owner roles, 10b5-1 flags, top-N, notional, hold days, or cooldown on these windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs materially new PIT evidence beyond raw C-code rows, such as parsed conversion purpose/lockup or selling-plan context, forward daily replacement observations from a shared default-off adapter, or 13D/13G holder-intent evidence that distinguishes control-holder supply relief from routine class conversion mechanics.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The Form 4 conversion no-disposal source did not clear Gate 4. C-code conversion semantics were likely routine class or compensation mechanics, already anticipated before next-open execution, or too concentrated in liquid leadership names to add replacement value beyond the existing OHLCV envelope.

prediction.confidence_reason: C-code class conversion is a distinct PIT Form 4 action not covered by M-code option exercise, S-code sale, or F-code withholding tests, but local coverage is only a few liquid leadership tickers, so the sample and concentration risks are high.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would remain only a replay lead until a shared default-off adapter loads the same PIT Form 4 transaction rows, applies the same C/A non-derivative conversion definition, excludes same-accession same-owner S/F D sale or tax-disposal rows, computes the same converted-share market-value and retention fields, uses the same OHLCV leadership envelope and same-ticker core overlap exclusion, and writes the same daily paper snapshot before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
